hints.title: In-Order Sorted Traversal Order
hints.text: Traversing the BST in-order visits node values in strictly ascending order.

hints.title: Right-Spine Pointer Rewiring
hints.text: Maintain a pointer to the tail of the newly formed increasing chain, linking each visited node as the right child.

hints.title: Left Pointer Nullification
hints.text: Detach the left pointer of each node by setting node.left to null before advancing the chain pointer to node.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import Optional

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

class Solution:
    def increasingBST(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        dummy = TreeNode(0)
        self.curr = dummy

        def inorder(node: Optional[TreeNode]):
            if not node:
                return
            inorder(node.left)
            node.left = None
            self.curr.right = node
            self.curr = node
            inorder(node.right)

        inorder(root)
        return dummy.right
```

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: In-place pointer rewiring during in-order traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Reallocating all new nodes into an array and creating new instances wastes extra memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Call stack scales with tree height H.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Rewire tree nodes in-place using in-order traversal with a dummy head.
